needscope.reading: Nandini and Amul own Belonging through cooperative, every-home ubiquity, crowding the classless-trust pole. Arokya and Jersey pull toward Security with functional health-and-quality cues, while Dodla straddles Belonging with a value-freshness tilt. Heritage sits in Belonging with a distinct pull toward Security — its whitespace is the daily-proven purity bridge that the cooperatives claim by scale but never verify at source.

cb: Bought as a reliable local pouch-milk habit, chosen on availability and price parity.
Consumed as everyday household milk for tea, coffee and cooking — rarely a deliberate choice.
Under-indexed among health-led young mothers who quietly trade up to organic or A2 alternatives.
db: Actively chosen by 25-44 women as the purity-assured milk for the family's daily nutrition.
Traded up within franchise: standard toned milk to fortified, curd, paneer and value-added variants.
Recommended in mother-and-child circles as the source-verified, quality-checked-every-day brand.
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: It's a good local milk, fresh enough and fairly priced — but honestly one brand is much like another.
ca_declarative: A convenient default, not a conscious choice.
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: Heritage is the milk I choose because I know exactly where it comes from and that it's checked every single day.
da_declarative: Purity you can trace, not just believe.
The confident choice for my family's nutrition.
cb_ca_db_da.caption: The desired attitude layers proven, traceable purity on top of Heritage's existing everyday-freshness trust — it deepens the anchor, it never replaces it.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From dependable local freshness to source-verified daily purity.

draft.smp: Heritage: pure nutrition, from pure milk, proven fresh every single day.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Claims trust through cooperative scale but cannot promise source-level purity verified daily for each consumer's milk.
Owns ubiquity and taste but its national aggregation model dilutes any single-source, freshly-checked-every-day guarantee.
Leans on a health-sounding name but has no equity in traceable farmer sourcing proven fresh daily.
Talks farmer freshness but frames it as value, not as an audited daily purity assurance for mothers.
Claims quality regionally but lacks a distinctive source-to-doorstep purity-checked-every-day proof point.

smp_unlocks.brand_line: Pure milk. Pure nutrition. Proven fresh, every day. — illustrative, not final copy
smp_unlocks.mass_line: Roz taaza, roz shuddh — seedha kisan se aapke ghar tak. — illustrative, not final copy
smp_unlocks.activation: 'Trace Your Milk' — a QR on every pack linking to the farm-cluster and that day's quality-check report, promoted through mother-and-baby and residential-community programmes. — illustrative, not final copy
smp_unlocks.product: A source-verified fortified range for young families, launched with a visible daily quality-check seal and freshness date. — illustrative, not final copy
